required_findings.quote: You can trace a small family habit back to whoever started it, including the person who insists they've never said that in their life.
required_findings.source_locator: baseline/R6_MASTER.md:810-817; Day 14 asks for a thing learned from a family member and naming who it came from. EN source provenance remains inherited from V3.
required_findings.finding: The heading and ordinary family examples are faithful. Tracing a habit to whoever started it adds an origin-finding task rather than noticing the family member from whom a participant picked it up.
required_findings.required_change: Keep direct borrowing/recognition: identify whom you picked the phrase or habit up from, without claiming its earliest origin can be established. The recognition joke can remain.

nonblocking_notes.note: Existing titles and exact section/supporting labels retain approved wording. Descriptive two-person variants are acceptable; PL01 was not required to gain W DWIE OSOBY, and PL02 retains that label. No packaging subtitle is rewritten.
Basic actions are allowed. Each article previews three distinct source days and neither prints a complete source day nor complete full-game rules.
